Project archive

Completed projects.

A record of earlier Digital Learning Lab research across higher education, writing, literacy, digital media, online learning, computer science, and inclusive technology.

← Current projects

Research archive

A foundation for what comes next.

Project SPROUT: Investigating Learning Environments in Higher Education

Examined instructional practices in large undergraduate STEM lecture courses and how those practices relate to student outcomes.

From Keystrokes to Achievement Scores

Analyzed national assessment data to study how prior access to computers and computer use relate to writing achievement.

Advancing the Use of Digital Museum Assets in Schools

Investigated how educators find, adapt, and use Smithsonian Learning Lab resources in K–12 classrooms.

Corpora Use in Second Language Learning

Examined how working with language corpora can support second-language vocabulary learning.

Cloud-Based Writing in K–12 Schools

Studied collaborative writing in Google Docs and its role in literacy learning, feedback, and classroom practice.

Digital Scaffolding for English Language Arts

Evaluated Visual Syntactic Text Formatting and its effects on reading and writing outcomes.

Virtual Inclusion via Telepresence Robots

Investigated classroom use of telepresence robots by homebound students, their teachers, and classmates.

Integrating Digital Storytelling in Classrooms

Partnered with DIGICOM and Palm Springs Unified School District to support teacher learning and classroom digital storytelling.

Learning Processes and Outcomes in MOOCs

Studied participation, learning processes, and educational outcomes in massive open online courses.

Multitasking as a Collaborative System

Examined how interactive media shape multitasking behavior, attention, and well-being among college students.

Distance and Blended Education in Developing Countries

Modeled how social engagement, online behavior, and student characteristics may predict persistence and performance.

Online Collaborative Problem Solving in College Mathematics

Compared small-group and individual problem solving in online pre-calculus courses.

Inclusive Uses of Digital Technologies

Examined how digital tools engage developmentally and linguistically diverse learners as readers and writers.

Investigating Virtual Learning Environments

Explored how virtual learning environments affect teaching, learning outcomes, and attitudes toward STEM in higher education.

CS1C@OC: A Network of Computer Science Teachers

Supported in-service teachers’ computer science knowledge, confidence, and evidence-based teaching practices for diverse learners.
